name: isaac_home_dev
_note: Development only (9 Nov 2026): validates composed Isaac homes, measures per-class Qwen3-VL recognisability and records a perception-capture dataset. Not an evaluation. Homes use the generator's development seeds 100-103 (the held-out seeds of the MuJoCo evaluation are 6000+ and are not touched). Nothing here is tuned against a result.
